modules.module_title: Install window air conditioner

pcs.pc_description: measure the space for installation to assure a good fit and air conditioner must be installed firmly into place to prevent vibration and noise
install the circuit breaker switch (if not available) and fix all the parts and components of window AC properly as per the instructions in manufacturer manual and SOP
install the drain pan over the corner of the cabinet and connect the drain hose to the outlet located on the bottom of the drain pan
install the AC unit in the window as per the instructions in manufacturer manual and SOP
ensure that the bottom of the cabinet is well supported, the top has minimum clearance and the air inlet louvers have clearance
connect the power cord with the circuit breaker switch, start the AC and check the functioning of AC by using remote
demonstrate the features and functioning of AC to the customer as per the instructions in manufacturer manual
guide the customer on proper placement, day to day care activities and precautions while using the air conditioner

modules.module_title: Install split air conditioner

pcs.pc_description: educate the customer of any pre installations/masonry/electrical work to be carried out and requirement of concealed drainage and electric conduits
make measurements at the location identified and drill holes ensuring no internal wiring damage takes place
mount the indoor unit and ensure that the screws are fastened securely
place the outdoor unit at a suitable location and attach it firmly to wall/floor
connect the indoor and the outdoor units using the field copper pipe of appropriate size and interconnecting cables
Verify inverter compatibility, refrigerant type (such as R-32 or R-290), and ensure proper use of digital tools and torque settings for leak-proof and efficient installation.
align the air conditioner according to the instruction manual
connect the power cord with the circuit breaker switch, start the AC and check the functioning of AC by using remote
Check the air conditioning gas, detect any leakage using electronic leak detectors, and fill additional gas (if required) as per manufacturer’s manual.
demonstrate to the customer about the features and utility of air conditioner
guide the customer on proper placement, day to day care activities and precautions while using the air conditioner

modules.module_title: Carryout troubleshooting and repairing of the air conditioner

pcs.pc_description: enquire about the problems/unusual conditions noticed on the equipment from the customer
check the air conditioner for any servicing requirements and clean the air conditioner filter, indoor and outdoor unit, drain hose etc. as per the SOP
carry out troubleshooting to identify faults such as power supply failure, less cooling, gas leakage, compressor or inverter PCB failure, and faulty components in the AC
refill the refrigerant gas if required by following instructions in manufacturer manual
unplug the unit and carry out basic tests such as power supply inspection, volt ampere test and earth test power supply, compressor, condenser etc.
separate and inspect every module of the unit if the fault is not identified through basic tests
inspect major components and identify that the faulty component to be repaired or replaced
dismantle the component for carrying out repair or replacement after is connecting it from power supply

remove and replace the faulty module with a functional one, either on a second visit or as preidentified and collected from the service centre, if the problem is at the PCB level or components that cannot be replaced at site
reassemble the module and air conditioner in complete and connect to power supply for checking the working
check all the modules working as per specifications
if the problem cannot be serviced onsite, then sent the unit to service center if the problem cannot be serviced onsite, then sent the unit to service center

check that all supporting accessories purchased are there in the pack
identify the place to fix the washing machine as per the need of customer
check for the availability of power outlet, surface level, water supply etc. needed for installing the water purifier as per the instructions in manufacturer manual and SOP
place the washing machine properly at levelled surface and at appropriate distance from the water supply as per SOP
connect the water hose and rain pipe with the washing machine and water supply tap as per the instructions in manufacturer manual and SOP
ensure that the machine is placed against an exterior wall to the drain hose running along the inside wall
remove all transport pins inside the drum of the washing machine before starting the machine
plug the power cord in the power outlet, start the washing machine and open the water supply valve
